scope:
Indigo Group will maintain the accounting records of the Company based on the supporting documents and information provided by management. The scope includes coding and entry of bank and cash payment vouchers, purchases and sales invoices, necessary journal entries and the generation of agreed accounting and financial reports.

The reporting package includes the trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, bank reconciliation, aged receivables and payables, and ledger extracts. Additional reports must be agreed in advance. Management will provide complete source records in a timely and orderly manner.

VAT registration assistance and preparation of VAT returns, and corporate tax compliance, are included only where expressly stated in the fee schedule and agreed scope. FTA correspondence must be forwarded promptly. Management reviews and approves submissions before filing.

Accounting software, transaction volume, reporting frequency, commencement date and any historic clean-up work will be agreed before the engagement begins.
timeline: We aim to close the monthly accounting records and deliver the agreed reports by the fifth working day of the following month, provided complete source documents and management responses are received on time. The reporting calendar, source-document deadlines and any tax-filing milestones will be agreed at commencement.
payment:
• Recurring fees — Recurring fees are invoiced in advance at the collection frequency shown in the fee schedule. A monthly fee collected quarterly is billed as three months together; this does not change the agreed monthly fee basis.

• Additional work — One-time assignments, historical clean-up and additional services are charged separately where itemised. Any work outside the agreed scope will be quoted for your approval before we proceed.

label: Accounting & annual audit
title: Accounting & annual audit
origin: Adapted from your supplied proposals · editable scope and blank fees
scope:
Indigo Group will maintain the accounting records of the Company based on the supporting documents and information provided by management. The scope includes coding and entry of bank and cash payment vouchers, purchases and sales invoices, necessary journal entries and the generation of agreed accounting and financial reports.

The reporting package includes the trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, bank reconciliation, aged receivables and payables, and ledger extracts. Additional reports must be agreed in advance. Management will provide complete source records in a timely and orderly manner.

VAT registration assistance and preparation of VAT returns, and corporate tax compliance, are included only where expressly stated in the fee schedule and agreed scope. FTA correspondence must be forwarded promptly. Management reviews and approves submissions before filing.

Accounting software, transaction volume, reporting frequency, commencement date and any historic clean-up work will be agreed before the engagement begins.

Annual audit: Coordinate the annual external audit for the financial reporting period and entity specified in this proposal. Confirm the appointed auditor, reporting framework and required recipient before issuing.

Management will provide complete accounting records, supporting documents and financial statements, respond to audit enquiries and approve the final financial statements. The audit report will be issued by the appointed auditor under the agreed engagement terms.
timeline: We aim to close the monthly accounting records and deliver the agreed reports by the fifth working day of the following month, provided complete source documents and management responses are received on time. The reporting calendar, source-document deadlines and any tax-filing milestones will be agreed at commencement.
payment:
• Payment arrangements — Recurring fees are invoiced in advance at the collection frequency shown in the fee schedule. A monthly fee collected quarterly is billed as three months together; this does not change the agreed monthly fee basis.

• Additional charges — One-time assignments, historical clean-up and additional services are charged separately where itemised. Any work outside the agreed scope will be quoted for your approval before we proceed.

• Invoice terms — Payment is due within 7 calendar days of the invoice date, unless a different due date is agreed in writing. The invoice currency and VAT treatment follow the fee schedule.
exclusions:
• Included services — The fees cover the services and selected add-ons listed in the fee schedule, subject to the service limits and reporting periods in the agreed scope.

• Additional work — Work outside the scope will be described and priced separately for your approval before it begins.

• Other costs — Government charges and third-party costs are included only where specifically stated.
profile:
Indigo Group supports clients across a range of financial and business needs, guided by an understanding of global business trends and sustained investment in a qualified, experienced team. We combine commercial insight with a personal service to develop practical financial solutions tailored to each client’s circumstances and objectives.

An integrated perspective
Our in-house team brings together financial advisory, corporate structuring and accounting expertise. We recognise that business decisions, tax obligations and personal wealth are closely connected. By considering these areas together, we help clients understand the wider financial implications of their decisions.

Independent advice
As a privately owned firm, we are independent of any particular bank or insurance company. We consider solutions according to each client’s circumstances and objectives, with clear explanations and transparency about fees.

Professional standards
Our professionals bring experience across the GCC and other international markets, supported by recognised accounting and finance qualifications. We combine technical knowledge, commercial understanding and current technology, with a commitment to accurate work, professional standards and confidentiality.

An international outlook
From our headquarters in Dubai, and through connections to Abu Dhabi, London, Dublin and Geneva, we bring an international perspective to the financial interests of our clients.
aims:
We provide clear advice, practical support and a coordinated service, with responsibilities and delivery milestones agreed from the outset.

• Understand your business — Agree your priorities, scope and deliverables before the engagement begins.

• Apply professional judgement — Combine relevant technical experience with careful review and attention to detail.

• Deliver to an agreed timetable — Set realistic milestones, explain dependencies and address outstanding information promptly.

• Communicate clearly — Keep you informed of progress, decisions and the actions needed from each party.

• Build lasting value — Support reliable reporting, effective processes and informed decisions as your business develops.
